content: Hello! This is Christine from Oakview Apartments. How can I assist you with your records or payments today?
Hi Christine, I'd like to double-check that my last maintenance fee payment was received. I made the transfer via Zelle yesterday.
Of course, happy to confirm. May I know the amount or reference you used, so I can quickly match it in your account?
Sure, I sent $175 to oakview-rentals@payportal.com at 3:45 PM. The reference on Zelle is #987654321.
Thank you! I see a Zelle transaction for $175 from 'Jamie D. Ortega' at 15:45 yesterday, ID #987654321, credited to Oakview's PayPortal. That matches your details exactly.
Perfect. Also, can you confirm my address on file? I've been getting some mail for unit 2B, but I'm in 3A.

Absolutely, Jamie. Your current registered address is 1144 Maple Lane, Apt 3A, Springfield, IL 62702. Your phone number is still (217) 555-0110. If you're receiving unit 2B's mail, I'll notify the building manager right away.
Thanks, I'd appreciate that. Is there anything else pending on my account?
As of this morning, your account ending in 1432 shows zero balance due, and all maintenance fees, including the $175 for June, are fully paid and cleared. No further action needed this month!
Great, thank you for confirming everything so quickly.
You're most welcome, Jamie! If you notice any new charges or urgent notices, we'll alert you right away at jamie.ortega@email.com. Have a wonderful day!
